'''The Wind Song Inn''' is an inn in [[Falme]].

==Appearance==
The Wind Song Inn is rather shabby, although it is fairly lively. It has a well-lit porch, and sounds of music and laughter. A large, noisy common room is filled with many customers. A fiddler plays near a hearth, while a barmaid dances beside him.

==History==
The Wind Song Inn enjoys a strange turn in fortunes. It was poorly run, with tasteless food, cramped food, and high prices, and was nearly driven out of business until the [[Seanchan]] landed in the region. The same factors keep the city's new occupiers out of the Wind Song Inn, and the establishment is therefore popular to those who heavily dislike Falme's new occupiers.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
